# Kimak

Headless UI library. React-first. Kernel in `@kimak/core`, adapter in `@kimak/headless-react`, product sugar in `@kimak/ui-react`.

Directories: `packages/headless/react`, `packages/ui/react`.

Styling contract: `[data-scope][data-slot][data-state]`. No design tokens.

Golden pair: Checkbox, Dialog. Do not expand the catalog until those two share spec, connect(), and tests.
